meta.unit_weight_for_clustering: one per unique sampled D county
meta.scope: Sampled D counties only; outcome-blind transductive characterization, not nationally representative or causal types.
meta.type_labels: 0..5, ordered by the smallest FIPS within each cluster; no causal interpretation
meta.continuous_geometry_update: Added after initial structure characterization, without rereading outcomes or changing any original lookup array.

preprocessing.fit_population: all distinct sampled D counties; no weights or outcomes

interpretation_limits: Clusters are coarse partitions of a continuous and correlated descriptor space.
Kish counts quantify concentration only; they are not independent event/county sample sizes.
Repeated county support is observational and does not establish matched weather exposure or causal contrasts.
All D geography defines the map. Downstream outcome analyses need event dependence, sparse-cell and multiplicity controls.
Descriptor scaling and equal-block weights are fixed conventions, not learned causal relevance weights.

continuous_geometry.method: Unweighted county PCA of the same imputed, standardized, five-block-equalized 46D geometry; full SVD, no whitening.
continuous_geometry.purpose: Continuous navigation of within-type and between-type variation; this is not a geographic map or a set of natural categories.
continuous_geometry.component_sign: Largest absolute component coefficient is positive; sign has no causal meaning.
continuous_geometry.loading_definition: Unit eigenvector coefficients on the block-equalized columns, not feature-outcome effects or feature-PC correlations.
continuous_geometry.distance_definition: Euclidean distance in the full 46D geometry, not in the 2D PCA display.
continuous_geometry.margin_definition: (second-nearest distance - nearest distance)/second-nearest distance; near zero indicates a weak boundary. It is not a probability.
continuous_geometry.projection_limit: Two PCs omit variation outside their span. Inspect the 46D descriptors, remaining PCs and full-space distances; visual proximity is not a matched-exposure or causal comparison.
